c813fd2bc859cb5fa88341f68769b6ced88b959f.summary: A Substack blog post by Natto Team, titled Part One of a piece on Russian extortion operations and hybrid warfare. It was published 2024-05-01 and archived 2026-11-25. The excerpt holds only quotes: Vladimir Putin's 2017 remarks and hacker Pavel Sitnikov's 2020 interview on state-aligned hacking, plus a truncated question about CL0P ransomware and U.S. critical infrastructure. The post is paywalled after the excerpt, so no findings, techniques or attributions appear in this text.
